messages:
maria: heads-up — after the ACL tweak to the keystore (rolled last night) we're seeing a spike of premerge SAST failures that mention decrypt errors and missing scanner creds. anyone who touched keystore perms?

alex: that was me, i removed a broad serviceAccount binding and scoped it down. i thought the scanner used an explicit service account, but sounds like pipeline still needs the old role. sorry.

jordan: can you paste the exact error from CI? i want to see if it's KMS:Decrypt or a different failure.

maria: gist of the CI failure: 
```
ERROR: failed to pull secrets
caused by: kms:Decrypt denied for resource projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/deploy-key
scanner-runner: exit code 1
```

alex: yep that's KMS:Decrypt. i restricted roles/* to a narrower binding. i can revert but would prefer a short-term exception. we should also update the perm matrix so this doesn't happen again.

samir: for triage — suggest granting the scanner pipeline ephemeral access instead of reverting. we have a pattern: create a short-lived binding via the deploy bot for 1h, and then rotate. That buys time for a proper RBAC change.

maria: agreed. can we get an audit log entry for the change? security needs to attach the ACL diff to the postmortem. i can't find the change in keystore audit logs (maybe log-level issue). @sec-bot any pointers?

sec-bot: detected permission-change event: principal=alex@redwood.com action=iam.setPolicy resource=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore timestamp=2025-11-03T03:12:07Z. audit_log_id=AL-20251103-3112. note: returned policy size: 2 bindings -> 1 binding.

jordan: thanks. maria — do you need the full IAM policy diff? i can pull it from cloud audit logs and attach.

maria: yes please. also we need list of PRs that started failing so product owners can be notified.

alex: i'll queue the ephemeral grant now with the deploy bot: `/deploy-bot grant scanner-runner@1h kms.decrypt` — will post confirmation.

pl-runner: running grant... granted scanner-runner -> role/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for 1h, expires at 2025-11-03T04:25:00Z. request id: RQ-5912.

samir: while the grant is up, ops should re-run the blocked CI jobs. also, we should patch the scanner to use the explicit service account if it's not already.

alex: i pushed a fix to the infra repo that maps the scanner SA to the correct binding and included a terraform plan. PR: infra#482. can someone review and approve? it's a single-line binding update.

maria: can we also add a CI check that fails the roll if the keystore audit log retention flag is not enabled? i want to avoid "no logs" during these changes.

jordan: good idea. we can add a preflight step in the release pipeline that checks audit log retention and the presence of a keystore-change approver label. i'll open a quick PR.

maria: for the postmortem — include timeline (who changed what), scan failures list, ephemeral grant id (RQ-5912), infra PR link, and remediation steps (backfill logs, add preflight, update RBAC runbook). also mark this as security-impacting and tag Customer Success if external-facing customers were affected.

alex: noted, i'll add my change summary + why i scoped down the binding (least privilege attempt). sorry for the churn.

samir: one more ask — can we add an automated smoke scan after any keystore policy change? small run that hits the scanner flow to verify KMS decrypt path. would catch this before it hits CI.

maria: +1. create a post-change smoke test job and require its green before merging keystore IAM diffs.

jordan: tracking tasks: infra PR review (alex), audit-log export & attach (jordan), postmortem draft (maria), smoke-test job (samir), preflight CI check (jordan). I'll update the security board.

maria: thanks all. quick wins: re-run blocked jobs now that grant is up, review infra PR, and i'll start the postmortem. :thumbsup:

alex: re-ran jobs, most green. two flaky hits unrelated to keystore — pinging owners.

maria: closing loop: mark incident as mitigated until infra PR merges and permanent binding is applied. will follow up with final postmortem once infra change is live.

sec-bot: incident ticket created: SEC-2025-903. severity: low-medium. linked resources: AL-20251103-3112, RQ-5912, infra#482.
